batting.dismissal: c RP Singh b P Parameswaran

balls.text: shuffles across, looking for a paddle sweep; RP fires a full toss outside off and the batsman fails to connect. Parthiv stops and has a shy at the striker's end but misses.
Just a single. RP is applying the squeeze here. Its a full delivery on the middle and Irfan edges the intended swing to the on side, down to fine-leg
another full delivery, again Van der Merwe mistimes his off drive and extra cover stops it
Irfan pulls but will just get a single as he finds the man at deep midwicket
full and around off, Van der Merwe pushes it towards mid-off for a single
short delivery, helped down to fine-leg region for a single
Parthiv goes flying! Fullish delivery outside off , Birt edges the intended cover drive and Parthv dives smartly to his left to take it with both hands.
Crash! Birt pulls a short delivery from outside off to the midwicket boundary.
yorker length outside off and Birt can't make contact

He went down on his knee and initially looked to paddle swat it. Vinay banged it short just outside off and Birt adjusted quickly, changed his mind, and put up the bat like a periscope and steered the ball up and over to the third man boundary! Wicked fun!
drives this through off for a single
around waist-high full toss outside off, the surprised batsman tries to cut it but fails
Birt moves outside leg, Param bangs it in short around off and Birt reaches out to carve it up and over point boundary
on the leg and middle, worked behind square-leg
full delivery outside off stump and Birt edges the intended big off drive to third man
short and just down the leg side and Birt laps it around the corner to fine-leg boundary
bangs it short of length and Birt edges it to his pad
Another one done in by the short ball. Venu is late on the pull this time and the ball lobs off the top edge to midwicket.
very full outside off and Birt tries to squeeze it out behind square on the off side but makes no contact
goes for a pull but ends up mistiming the ball to long-on
overpitching continues, the square driving too continues and sweeper cover cuts off the ball again
gets forward to tap it to the off side for a single
Overpitches this one as well, driven to sweeper cover
Lash! overpitched well outside off and Birt square drives it to the point boundary.
very full and Birt inside edges it to short fine-leg region
works this through square-leg for couple of runs
leans forward to pus this to the on side

Venu bhai! Again that sense of timing. It was a very full delivery and it appeared for a moment that he was yorked there and didn't have much room to work with. But he adjusted, got the bat down in a hurry, opened the bat-face and steered it wide of short third man
just outside off stump, cut away to deep backward point
gets forward to drive this to sweeper cover for a single
around the off stump line, steered through to deep backward point
Done in by the bouncer. He  top edged the previous pull to mid-on. This time the ball is shorter and it rears up at his throat. He is again beaten for pace and bounce and top-edges this to fine-leg
drifts to the pads and rolls away for a leg bye
slips this wide down the leg side
straightens in the corridor outside off and Venu is beaten, pushing inside the line
banged in short, Yogesh goes for a pull but is late on it. The ball lobs off the edge and falls at mid-on region. The fielder comes in from the deep
on a length, on the middle, turned to square-leg
leans across to ping sweeper cover
fullish and straight, on driven to long-on
leans forward to nudge this length delivery to point
in the zone outside off and it angles past the defensive push, and Parthiv collects
Edged through vacant slips! It was a length delivery outside off stump, the batsman frees his arms and the ball flies off the edge
short and wide, cut away to point
low full toss around off stump and Venu, as ever, concentrates on getting the timing and the placement right. No violence. He leaned forward and timed it to left of long-off
full, very full, squeezed out to short mid-on region for a single
on the pads, turned through square leg for a single
in the channel outside off, Venu tries to late cut it but misses out
full in length on the middle, eased down to long-on
reaches across to cut this widish delivery and Hodge rushes across to his left at sweeper cover to prevent the four
gets forward to drive this hard to long-off
just outside off, run down to short third man region
steers this to third man for a single

What was that?! Immense fun. Not that Mahela will agree. Vinay tries the slower one and it comes horribly out of his hand. The ball lands very very short down the track, bounces once and bounces again and Nagar, who stopped his initial attempt at pulling and waited, lunged out to crash-pull it after the second bounce to midwicket boundary. Mahela reckons it should be a dead ball and speaks to the umpire. Dead ball only if it had bounced thrice.
leans forward to tap this to covers for a single
in the zone outside off, Venu goes for the cut but misses
tries to sweep this but doesn't make proper contact
gets forward to drive this to long-on
fullish outside off, driven to sweeper cover
pushes this wide down the leg side
quickish one, turned to backward square-leg

Stumping chance? Venu moves down the track and Jadeja's release goes awry and the ball ends up bouncing outside leg. Rao misses the pull and turns back in a hurry. But Patel didn't collect it cleanly. Even if he had , not sure whether he would have broken the stumps in time
on the leg stump line, turned to short fine-leg. Chance of a run out</b. as Yogesh Nagar charges across. He turns and rushes back. The throw hits him on the back and he survives
gets back to clip this past square-leg for a single
overpitched outside off, square driven to deep point
opens the bat-face and runs this slower one to third man
Sweet! Similar delivery but this time Venu doesn't lunge; he leans across, opens the bat-face and steers it to right of backward point. All timing.
full and outside off, Venu lunges across to try guide it past point but makes no contact
goes for a big heave-ho but hits it uppishly and short of long-on
gets forward to turn this to the on side
around the pads, clipped away for couple of runs
shout for lbw ; the ball landed on a length just outside off and moved towards the leg stump. It would have clipped the bails, according to hawk eye
goes for a bouncer and Yogesh allows it to climb over him
gets forward to tuck it past square-leg for a single
lands on a length and moving in, shuffles to turn to to the leg side but it rolls of the pad
full and outside off, the batsman goes hard into a forcing drive and ends up mistiming it to the off.
leans forward to steer this good-length to point
leans across to push the full-length delivery to point
full and outside off stump, left alone
drives this very full delivery to left of mid-on for a single
angling away from the batsman, left alone
on the middle stump line, turned to midwicket
gets forward to defend the good-length delivery back to the bowler
short in length outside off sutmp and Venu stands on his toes and punches it ever so sweetly through extra cover. Impressive hit.
in the zone outside off, left alone
Leather on wood! It's a full delivery outside off stump, Naman Ojha goes for the off drive but gets an edge through to the keeper
angling away from the batsman who watches it sail through to the keeper
pushes this wide outside off stump.
around the off stump line, defended to the off side
Fatal attraction to the pull has done him in. It wasn't all that short and it was angling away from him but Warner went for the shot. Not wise. The ball lobbed to mid-on
defends this length delivery to the off side

Houston! We have a man down! He cleared the front foot and went for a crashing pull. He missed and the ball hit him on the back thigh. And he slowly went down on to the ground in pain. He is up quickly, though
nice slower one but its a no ball. Warner pushes it quietly to the off
Not all that short but Warner, who loves to hang on his back foot, gets his bottom hand working over time to punch-pull it over midwicket
on a length on the middle, tucked through midwicket. Warner wanted second run, his partner didn't and Warner got back in time to beat the throw
taps this gently to point for a quick single
drifts to the pads and Ojha whips it to the square-leg boundary. Nice and easy.
leans forward to drive to mid-off
Sehwag spirit has taken over. Full pitched outside off - not too dissimilar to the delivery that Sehwag whacked over long-off- and Ojha crashes this over wide long-off boundary
gets across to push this out to covers
lands on a length and angles past the outside edge of Ojha, who searches for the white ball
pushes this past the lunging bowler for a single
leans forward to defend this length delivery
works this to behind square-leg for a run
No McCullum or Hodge to save Sreesanth this time. A full toss outside off and Warner cuts it away to the point boundary
that man Brendon again. This time too he lunges to his left to stop the drive with his left hand.
Again Warner goes back to a full delivery. That's the way he plays. He sits on the back foot and drives this hard but Mccullum makes a super diving stop at short extra cover
And this time the Dinesh Kartik style defensive push to mid-off. The pad comes first and then the bat comes right in front of it as he pushes it out to the off
full in length, around off, driven out to covers, ala Mohammad Kaif,
leans across to defend to the off side

Shortish, outside off and Sehwag reaches out for a cut. Well, not quite a cut but a weak waft, as if he was just trying to run it down to third man.Edge and taken by the keeper.  The umpires have told him to wait They want to check the no ball.  More drama There didn't seem to be any part of the foot behind the line or so it appears to me. May be another replay will clear it up for me. My first reactions on seeing that replay was that it was a no ball. Hope they show another replay. I missed it but lots of  you readers have mailed in saying that the replays showed that he landed his foot just behind the line before it slid across.
And he defends this one. Compact. Solid.

Blistering hit! Out of the ground! The white ball has sailed into the night. Bye bye! Fullish delivery, outside off stump and Sehwag turns imperious. Full clean swing of the bat and the ball soars over long-off
homing in on the off stump line, Warner was on the back foot- it was a full delivery- and he pushes it to mid-off
No width on this, just a touch outside off, but Sehwag stays beside the line, creates his own room and lashes it down to third man
More width. Over pitched as well. Warner cover drives but Brad Hodge makes a nice diving stop to prevent the boundary
again some width outside off, Warner lets this one go through to the keeper

Neat! Another widish delivery, fuller this time, and Warner presses back and across, shifts his weight back, leans his body across, gets his hands away from the body, reaches the ball and square drives it through point
keeps a touch low as it skids away well outside off, Warner reaches out to push it out to covers
Swat! He is back, our man Sehwag. The last ball was just an aberration. This was a short delivery angling across him and he swivels to swat-pull it over wide midwicket
on the middle and leg, full; surprisingly Sehwag doesn't whip it through wide midwicket but pushes it softly towards mid-on.
leans forward to drive this neatly but straight to covers
banged in short and it flies outside off, Sehwag sways away
Ah well ... Sehwag whip-lashes his first delivery  - a length delivery outside off - up and over point! RP sticks his tongue out.
on a length, on the middle, tucked wide of mid-on for an easy single
Kochi have won it with five overs to spare. Parthiv runs this down to third man for the victory run.
skips down the track and whip-flicks this aerially to wide long-on boundary. Just one more now.
in the corridor outside off and Parthiv is beaten, pushing inside the line
hits this hard but straight to sweeper cover
Crushed! Shortish delivery and Brad pulls it over the square-leg boundary
gets down the track, moves outside leg and slaps to point boundary
slower, turns to move past the prod and hits the pad. Going down leg
on the middle and off line, chopped away to backward point
gets forward to work it to midwicket
floated outside off, full, driven back to the bowler
leans forward to flick it to deep square-leg region
on the pads, tucked to midwicket for a single
gets down the track and taps this through midwicket
backs away to cut to sweeper cover
tries to heave this free-hit delivery over midwicket and top edges it for a single
turned just behind square-leg and they hesitate over the single and decide not to take it. No ball.
Wham! Again, he advances down the track and this time pings the cover boundary
Hodgy podgy crashes this over the sight screen. He sashayed down the track and tonked this to the straight boundary
leans forward to turn it wide of mid-on for a single
in the zone outside off, left alone
fullish delivery around off, driven out to mid-off
short in length, just outside off, cut down to third man
the awkward lifter rears up at a surprised Parthiv who stabs it off the outer edge and it flies over to third man boundary
gets forward to unfurl the punchy drive to long-off boundary
full in length outside off, pushed out to covers
slower, fuller, driven to mid-off
drifts to the pads and Parthiv loves the whippy flick. The ball rushes to the square-leg boundary
around off stump, guided to backward point

short in length, around off ,tapped towards cover and Hodge calls Parthiv for a very quick single. Van der Merwe (was it?) rushed forward and threw but missed the stumps. Had he hit, Patel would have been struggling out there
inside edge the intended off drive for a single

full and on the legs, flicked away to right of fine-leg region where Morne does all the hard work to reach there and stop it with a tumble but fails to hold on to the ball ; the ball rolls away to the boundary

Mahela survives a lbw shout but is run out! He got an inside edge to his pad on his across the line waft and the ball rolled to short third man. Nagar was very quick to react; he swooped on the ball, threw himself forward as he under-armed a direct hit. Mahela, seemingly unaware of what was happening behind him, was late in trying to get bat inside the crease
turns this to midwicket for a single
goes for the sweep and doesn't connect properly.  It landed around leg, turned in slightly to strike him in front of leg. It would have clipped the leg stump
nicely flighted delivery but Mahela plays  a superb shot. Lovely stylish elegant waft of the wand and he plays it with the turn and over extra cover
leans forward to whip it from outside off to deep midwicket
gets forward to push this through the off side.
around the off stump line, clipped to deep square-leg
the bouncer arrives and Mahela allows it to pass over him
whips this back of length delivery to deep square-leg
on the middle and leg, tapped to right of midwicket for a quick single. Had Birt's throw hit the stumps,Patel would have been run out
reaches outside off and steers to backward point
fullish delivery on leg and middle, flicked past square-leg
Yep. Wide down the leg side. Regular programming resumes
leans forward to nudge this behind square-leg
this one too keeps slightly low, jabbed to short fine-leg region
punches it through to sweeper cover
yet another wide. How many is too many for Delhi?
leans forward to defend this back to the bowler

Dead plumb. That ball kept low, not quite a rank shooter but low enough to fool the batsman. Klinger went back to defend the short of length delivery but it skidded very low  towards middle and hit him between his ankle and knee
gets forward to defend this length delivery to covers
on the hips, tucked past square-leg
short in length, just outside off, guided to backward point
Aagarkar bowls the bouncer and the ball climbs over the batsman
just outside off stump, run down to right of third man for couple of runs
short in length, around middle and leg, dabbed to the on side
short and climbing outside off, Patel chops it to point region
And another wide. The camera pans to Sehwag who is busy chewing gum. Wonder what brand he uses
on the middle stump line, dabbed to the on side
drifts down the leg side and the keeper collects. Parthiv tried to flick it but didn't connect
bounces outside off, left alone
shortish delivery, pulled away to deep square-leg for a single
on the hips, tucked to short fine-leg region. No ball, though
on a length around off stump line, nudged down to third man
dismissed in the way Warner fell. Brendon went for the pull but ended up swatting it straight to mid-on. Morne puts his index finger up and the tattooed batting star heads back to the hut.
full pitched on middle, flicked away to short midwicket
Ifran Pathan just stands there and stares ahead at nothing in particular. Klinger had just rushed down the track and whacked this full delivery through wide mid-off
goes hard into the cut and ends up mistiming it to covers
he leans forward and whips the length delivery on the pads up and over midwicket
full and drifting to the pads, Klinger fails to connect with his pull and it rolls off the pad
on the middle stump line, full in length, pushed back to the bowler
rushes down the track and slams this full delivery to cover point boundary. Kochi have rocketed to 53!
Thump! Yadav lands this one and it's a short-pitched delivery. Blink. The ball is being thrown back from wide midwicket boundary. Crashing pull

Six over fine-leg and it was a beamer! It was almost a chest-high bouncer and McCullum, who was shaping to pull, tried to pull out of the shot. he took his eyes off the ball and just wafted at it. The ball flew over fine-leg!
hurls across a high bouncer - 148.3 kmph delivery- and it flies over McCullum.
gets back to defend the short of length delivery to the off
Top shot. It's a length delivery outside off and Brendon drives it through extra cover.
flicks this to deep backward square-leg for a single
full in length and moves away after landing outside off, Klinger goes for a big off drive and misses

cry for lbw. The ball landed on a length around middle and leg and straightened to hit the pad. McCullum tried the short-arm pull but it wasn't the length for it. Did it strike him a touch high? Replays please
in the zone outside off, run down to third man
moves down the track, tries to unfurl the pull but ends up lapping it down to long leg
gets forward to whip the length delivery through midwicket
threatens to jump out, holds his position and dabs the length delivery to midwicket
gets forward to drive the full-length delivery to mid-off
around the off stump line, sliced away to backward point
digs it in short on the hips, McCullum shuffles across and unfurls the leg glance
extra bounce on this short ball outside off, McCullum goes for the cut over point but the ball flashes over the blade
Imperious! He rushed down the track, moved slightly outside leg and absolutely walloped this over to the cover boundary
this one cuts in, McCullum chooses to shoulder arms and his heart would have been in his mouth as the ball kept coming in and it wasn't all that far away from the off stump
Creamed! Fullish delivery outside off and Brendon square drives it through point
leans forward to defend it to the off
The keeper is back for Klinger and so, he is able to stop this wide down the leg side from running away to the boundary
Irfan continues to struggle with his line. This is full and on the pads, flicked down to fine-leg boundary
full and on the leg and middle line, the ball rolls out to square-leg
Another one down the leg side, Another wide.
sprays this wide down the leg side and with the keeper standing up to the stumps, it was always going to be 5 wides
just outside the off stump line, pushed out to mid-off
hint of inward movement but drifting on the pads, rolls away towards square-leg
lands on a length around off and middle and moves in towards middle, defended to the on side of the pitch
